key_insight: The paper extends link-middle-cut lower bounds from linear reversible circuits to full Clifford circuit synthesis, yielding efficient, tight CNOT lower bounds for important cases such as qubit permutations.
engineering_relevance: These bounds help quantum compiler and hardware teams estimate and optimize CNOT cost, proving optimality and improving heuristic synthesis for Clifford circuits.
method: Represent Clifford operators with binary symplectic tableaux.
Define block-support connectivity graphs and determinantal invariants to derive lower bounds.
Use the lower bound as an admissible heuristic in A*-based synthesis and support synthesis up to output-qubit permutation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that benchmark A* search using the new bounds could prove optimality beyond earlier SAT-based methods and improve CNOT counts when combined with prior heuristics.
watch_item: The strongest tightness guarantee is shown for qubit permutations and the broader lower-bound effectiveness depends on tableau-based computations and heuristic search quality.
paper_title: Link-middle-cut lower bounds for Clifford circuit synthesis
